opis: Element wyskakuje i lekko się sprężynuje.

przepis.opis_efektu: Graphic or text element pops onto the screen with a spring scale animation: starts at scale 0, overshoots to scale 1.15, then settles at scale 1.0. Total animation: 300ms (0→1.15 in 200ms, 1.15→1.0 in 100ms). Apply to each new graphic card, text label or icon as it enters the frame. Trigger each pop-in on the word or beat it illustrates. Elements stay on screen after appearing — they do not exit unless a new scene begins. Max 2–3 elements visible at once to avoid clutter.
